name: intersecting_iff_pairwise_not_disjoint
statement: s.Intersecting ↔ (s.Pairwise fun a b => ¬Disjoint a b) ∧ s ≠ {⊥}

name: Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq
statement: (s : Set α).Intersecting) : (∀ t : Finset α, (t : Set α).Intersecting → s ⊆ t → s = t) ↔ 2 * #s = Fintype.card α

name: Intersecting.exists_card_eq
statement: (s : Set α).Intersecting) : ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ 2 * #t = Fintype.card α ∧ (t : Set α).Intersecting
